messages:
Ava: bringing up marlin11b (int4) on canary. baseline qps ok, but we see OOMs when max_new_tokens > 256 and memory fragmentation after ~30m of steady traffic. throwing this here in case anyone has seen the pattern. logs attached inline below. :eyes:

Devon: can you paste the config you used for batching/prefetch? are you running windowed batching or fixed?

Ava: running windowed with target_batch_size=64, max_latency_ms=60, prefetch=2. model loaded with kv_cache enabled, slot_reserve=0. sample log: 

```

[2026-03-18T15:12:03Z] worker-3 WARNING: alloc failed: request 48MB -> OOM
[2026-03-18T15:12:03Z] worker-3 INFO: attempted kv evict, free=12MB
[2026-03-18T15:12:04Z] worker-3 INFO: fragmentation: largest_free=8MB, total_free=20MB
[2026-03-18T15:12:05Z] scheduler DEBUG: max_new_tokens=320, batch_size=48

```

Priya: interesting. when you lowered max_new_tokens to 256 does the OOM go away entirely or just less frequent? also any diff in prompt lengths?

Ava: drops to near zero when max_new_tokens <=256. avg prompt length is ~80 tokens, p95 around 210. the failures cluster on requests that hit both kv-prefetch and long responses ( > 280 tokens total).

Levi: hypothesis: fragmentation from repeated large allocations for long outputs + prefetch buffer growth. two low-friction mitigations: 1) enable slot_reserve=32MB, 2) set prefetch=1 and bump target_batch_size down to 48 for the canary. also consider limiting max_window_size or using adaptive-window (if available) to avoid oversized batches for long-generation tails.

Devon: +1 on slot_reserve. also try turning on early_kv_evict=true so idle KV segments free sooner. we had a similar case with orion-lite where slot_reserve=24MB fixed tail OOMs.

Priya: i ran an eval over our regression suite — quality delta for int4 vs fp16 is tiny on marlin11b for our tasks. lowering max_new_tokens to 256 only affects a tiny fraction of our end-to-end tests (long-form summarization), we can fallback to fp16 for those endpoints.

Ava: testing Levi's config now: slot_reserve=32MB, prefetch=1, target_batch_size=48, early_kv_evict=true. will report back in ~20m.

infra-bot: deploy request received: canary marlin11b-int4 -> 3nodes, policy: canary-5pct. started rollout at 2026-03-18T15:18:20Z. logs forwarded to /var/logs/marlin11b/canary.log

Levi: if that fixes it we should add a model-defaults patch: set slot_reserve=32MB and prefetch=1 for marlin11b-int4, and mark max_new_tokens default at 256 with a note for long-form endpoints. create an eval to capture long-tail regen tests.

Ava: quick update: after ~12m on canary with new config we saw zero OOMs and fragmentation metric stabilized (largest_free remained >28MB). latency p95 +30ms but within SLO. will run a 2h soak tonight. :thumbsup:

Devon: great. ticket to follow: "marlin11b int4 defaults and longform fallback" — we'll also add documentation blurb about when to bump max_new_tokens and the tradeoffs.

Priya: noted — i'll add the fallback eval and a runbook entry for ops if OOMs reoccur.

Ava: thanks all. keeping thread open until soak completes.
